Scenario fixture: reflow-horizontal-scroll (WCAG 1.4.10)

Each target has a stable id of the form reflow_case_NN. The rule applies only to a page laid out at a viewport 320 CSS pixels wide or less, so load this page at that width (the browser test does). It needs a layout, so in jsdom it reports nothing: each case's data-outcome-reflow-horizontal-scroll attribute gives that jsdom verdict, and the browser test checks the one in the title. The cases that stick out make the page scroll sideways; the cases where the page is kept from scrolling (CLIPPED_AT_VIEWPORT_EDGE) and the one with no element to name (HORIZONTAL_SCROLL_UNATTRIBUTED) need a page of their own, and are covered by the browser test's own pages.

A. Fits the width

01 — PASS: a paragraph that wraps

Opening hours today, and the rest of the week from nine to five.

02 — PASS: an image that shrinks to fit
03 — PASS: a wide data table in a box that scrolls on its own
Day Opens
Monday 9:00

B. Sticks out (the page scrolls sideways)
